# ⚙️ This tree is MACHINE-WRITTEN — do not edit

Every file under this directory is generated by
`plugin-core/scripts/build_bundles.py` from `plugin-core/` (and the canonical
risk classifier in `mcp_server/`). A fresh build **fully regenerates** the tree
— hand edits are overwritten and files the generator no longer emits are
deleted.

To change anything here, edit the source instead:

| You want to change | Edit |
|---|---|
| Gate logic / hooks | `plugin-core/gate_core/` |
| Host adapters | `plugin-core/gate_core/host/` |
| Skills | `plugin-core/skills/` |
| Manifest / hooks.json / README / commands | `plugin-core/bundles/claude/` |
| Risk classifier / signals | `mcp_server/risk_classifier.py` + `risk_signals.json` |
| Versions & platform facts | `plugin-core/platforms.yaml` |

Then regenerate: `python plugin-core/scripts/build_bundles.py`

CI enforces sync via `tests/test_bundle_generator.py`.
